description_en: Calls the ModifyActiveOperationTasks operation to modify the scheduled switchover time of O&M tasks
description_zh: 调用ModifyActiveOperationTasks接口修改运维任务的计划切换时间
name: ModifyActiveOperationTasks

parameters.help_en:
The O&M task IDs. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,).

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/414458.html to obtain O&M task IDs
parameters.help_zh:
运维任务ID，多个ID间使用英文逗号（,）分隔。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/414458.html获取运维任务ID
parameters.name: ids

parameters.help_en:
The scheduled switchover time to set. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format (UTC).

The time cannot be later than the deadline. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/414458.html and check the value of the Deadline response parameter to obtain the deadline
parameters.help_zh:
要设置的计划切换时间，格式为_yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ_（UTC时间）。

不能晚于最晚操作时间，您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/414458.html，通过返回参数**Deadline**的值来获取最晚操作时间
parameters.name: switch_time

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to immediately execute the O&M task. Valid values:

1: immediately executes the task.
0: executes the task at the specified time
parameters.help_zh:
是否立即执行运维任务，取值：

1：立即执行。
0：指定时间执行
parameters.name: immediate_start

Ids.description_en: The O&M task IDs. Multiple IDs are separated with commas (,)
Ids.description_zh: 运维任务ID，多个ID间使用英文逗号（,）分隔
